items.statement: Manufacture drugs for use in a phase 1 study in compliance with the drug product CGMP regulations once the investigational drug has been made available in a phase 2 or phase 3 study or the drug has been lawfully marketed.
items.quote: If the investigational drug has been made available in a phase 2 or phase 3 study or the drug has been lawfully marketed, the drug for use in the phase 1 study must comply with part 211.
